paper_title: Constraints on axionlike dark matter with masses down to $10^{-23}$ eV/c$^2$
notes: Eot-Wash rotating torsion pendulum with ~1e23 polarized electrons searching for axionlike DM wind over masses 1e-23 to 1e-18 eV. Paper reports limit as Fa/Ce >~ 2e15 eV (i.e. Ce/Fa <~ 5e-16 eV^-1). Data points are approximate conversions to dimensionless g_ae using g_ae = 2*m_e*Ce/Fa (m_e=511 keV); convention uncertain so confidence reduced. Limit roughly flat over most of range, degrading near sidereal bump (~47 zeV) and at highest masses due to finite measurement-duration attenuation. Abstract states 1e15 but body/Fig.5 states 2e15 eV.
